summary: Park Ha Biological Technology Co., Ltd. filed a Form 6-K disclosing a private placement of 10,000,000 Class A ordinary shares with warrants to purchase up to 2,000,000 Class A ordinary shares, at a combined price of US$0.18 per share and warrant, for gross proceeds of approximately US$1.8 million. The transaction closed on August 3, 2026, under Regulation S to non-U.S. investors. Proceeds will fund general working capital. This is a routine private placement, not a special situation such as a rights offering or restructuring.
